moringa-powder.name: Moringa Powder
moringa-powder.description: Nutrient-dense leaf powder rich in vitamins, minerals and antioxidants. Perfect for smoothies and teas.
moringa-powder.history: Moringa has been used for centuries in traditional Ayurvedic medicine and African healing practices. Known as the 'Miracle Tree' for its extensive health benefits and nutritional value.
benefits: Rich in vitamins A, C, and E
High in calcium and iron content

baobab-powder.name: Baobab Powder
baobab-powder.description: Vitamin-C rich fruit pulp powder with prebiotic fiber and a citrus-tangy taste. Excellent for digestive health.
baobab-powder.history: The Baobab tree, known as the 'Tree of Life' in Africa, has been used for thousands of years in traditional African medicine and nutrition. Its fruit is harvested from ancient trees that can live up to 3,000 years.

dried-mango.name: Dried Mango
dried-mango.description: Sweet, chewy dried mango slices with no added sugar. Naturally sun-dried to preserve nutrients and flavor.
dried-mango.history: Mango cultivation in Nigeria dates back centuries, with the fruit holding cultural significance in West African traditions. Drying mangoes was a traditional preservation method that allowed communities to enjoy the fruit year-round.
benefits: Rich in vitamins A and C

dried-pineapple.name: Dried Pineapple
dried-pineapple.description: Tropical dried pineapple chunks with natural sweetness. Perfect for snacking or adding to trail mixes.
dried-pineapple.history: Pineapple has been cultivated in tropical regions for centuries. In Nigeria, pineapple farming has become an important agricultural practice, with traditional sun-drying methods preserving the fruit's natural goodness.
benefits: Rich in vitamin C and manganese

dried-papaya.name: Dried Papaya
dried-papaya.description: Sweet and tender dried papaya chunks rich in digestive enzymes. Naturally dried to maintain nutritional value.
dried-papaya.history: Papaya has been used in traditional medicine across tropical regions for its digestive and healing properties. Nigerian cultivation preserves traditional growing methods while ensuring premium quality.
benefits: High in vitamins C and A

stevia-powder.name: Stevia Powder
stevia-powder.description: Natural zero-calorie sweetener from stevia leaves. Perfect for beverages, baking, and diabetic-friendly recipes.
stevia-powder.history: Stevia has been used for centuries by indigenous peoples in South America. Modern cultivation in Nigeria adapts this ancient sweetener to tropical conditions while maintaining its natural purity.
benefits: Zero calories and zero glycemic impact
Does not affect blood sugar levels

cocoa-powder.name: Cocoa Powder
cocoa-powder.description: Rich, dark cocoa powder with intense chocolate flavor. Unprocessed and perfect for beverages and baking.
cocoa-powder.history: Cocoa has deep roots in West African agriculture, with Nigeria being one of the world's cocoa producers. Traditional processing methods preserve the bean's natural antioxidants and flavor compounds.

wild-forest-honey.name: Wild Forest Honey
wild-forest-honey.description: Raw, unfiltered honey harvested from wild forest regions. Rich in natural enzymes and floral notes.
wild-forest-honey.history: Traditional honey harvesting in Nigeria's forests dates back generations, with beekeepers using sustainable methods that respect the natural ecosystem and wild bee populations.
